theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.map_bondSum_ne_semf_neutronMatter {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (τ : R →+* K) {epp epn enn npp npn nnn : R} {E0 aV aA A : K} (hepp : 0 ≤ τ epp) (hepn : 0 ≤ τ epn) (henn : 0 ≤ τ enn) (hpp : 0 ≤ τ npp) (hpn : 0 ≤ τ npn) (hnn : 0 ≤ τ nnn) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E0) (hA : 0 < A) (h : aV < aA) :
E0 * τ (BondCutSymmetry.bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn) ≠ aV * A - aA * (A * A / A)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.map_bondSum_nonneg {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (τ : R →+* K) {epp epn enn npp npn nnn : R} (hepp : 0 ≤ τ epp) (hepn : 0 ≤ τ epn) (henn : 0 ≤ τ enn) (hpp : 0 ≤ τ npp) (hpn : 0 ≤ τ npn) (hnn : 0 ≤ τ nnn) :
0 ≤ τ (BondCutSymmetry.bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.flavour_factor_to_leave_hull {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {c df₀ : K} (hdf : 0 < df₀) (hout : ¬(0 ≤ offsetRatio (c * df₀) ∧ offsetRatio (c * df₀) ≤ 1)) :
c < -2 / df₀ ∨ 2 / df₀ < c

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.offsetRatio_mem_of_small {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {df : K} (h0 : 0 < df) (h2 : df ≤ 2) :
0 ≤ offsetRatio df ∧ offsetRatio df ≤ 1

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.offsetRatio_mem_iff {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {df : K} :
0 ≤ offsetRatio df ∧ offsetRatio df ≤ 1 ↔ -2 ≤ df ∧ df ≤ 2

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.interface_flavour {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (z h df : K) :
letterTrace z (-(h * offsetRatio df)) = (1 - offsetRatio df) * letterTrace z 0 + offsetRatio df * letterTrace z (-h)

def QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.offsetRatio {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (df : K) :
K

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.energySlope_tower {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {ι : Type u_3} (s : Finset ι) (c epp epn enn : ι → K) :
BondCutSymmetry.energySlope (∑ k ∈ s, c k * epp k) (∑ k ∈ s, c k * epn k) (∑ k ∈ s, c k * enn k) = ∑ k ∈ s, c k * BondCutSymmetry.energySlope (epp k) (epn k) (enn k)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.energySlope_mul {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (c epp epn enn : K) :
BondCutSymmetry.energySlope (c * epp) (c * epn) (c * enn) = c * BondCutSymmetry.energySlope epp epn enn

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.energySlope_add {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (epp epn enn epp' epn' enn' : K) :
BondCutSymmetry.energySlope (epp + epp') (epn + epn') (enn + enn') = BondCutSymmetry.energySlope epp epn enn + BondCutSymmetry.energySlope epp' epn' enn'

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.energySlope_map {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [Field K] [Field L] (τ : K →+* L) (epp epn enn : K) :
τ (BondCutSymmetry.energySlope epp epn enn) = BondCutSymmetry.energySlope (τ epp) (τ epn) (τ enn)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.letterSum_tower {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (c : κ → R) (f : ι → κ → R) :
∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, c k * f i k = ∑ k ∈ t, c k * ∑ i ∈ s, f i k

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.interface_affine_map {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (τ : R →+* S) (z h u : R) :
τ (letterTrace z (-(h * u))) = (1 - τ u) * τ (letterTrace z 0) + τ u * τ (letterTrace z (-h))

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.interface_affine_weight {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (z h w : R) :
letterTrace z (-(h * (1 - w))) = w * letterTrace z 0 + (1 - w) * letterTrace z (-h)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.interface_affine {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (z h u : R) :
letterTrace z (-(h * u)) = (1 - u) * letterTrace z 0 + u * letterTrace z (-h)

def QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.letterTrace {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (z d : R) :
R

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.bondSum_tower {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u_3} (s : Finset ι) (c epp epn enn : ι → R) (npp npn nnn : R) :
BondCutSymmetry.bondSum (∑ k ∈ s, c k * epp k) (∑ k ∈ s, c k * epn k) (∑ k ∈ s, c k * enn k) npp npn nnn = ∑ k ∈ s, c k * BondCutSymmetry.bondSum (epp k) (epn k) (enn k) npp npn nnn

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.bondSum_zero_energies {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (npp npn nnn : R) :
BondCutSymmetry.bondSum 0 0 0 npp npn nnn = 0

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.bondSum_mul_energies {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (c epp epn enn npp npn nnn : R) :
BondCutSymmetry.bondSum (c * epp) (c * epn) (c * enn) npp npn nnn = c * BondCutSymmetry.bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.bondSum_add_energies {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (epp epn enn epp' epn' enn' npp npn nnn : R) :
BondCutSymmetry.bondSum (epp + epp') (epn + epn') (enn + enn') npp npn nnn = BondCutSymmetry.bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn + BondCutSymmetry.bondSum epp' epn' enn' npp npn nnn

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.two_mul_bondSum_map {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (τ : R →+* S) (epp epn enn npp npn nnn dP dN : R) (hP : 2 * npp + npn = dP) (hN : 2 * nnn + npn = dN) :
2 * τ (BondCutSymmetry.bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn) = τ epp * τ dP + τ enn * τ dN + (2 * τ epn - τ epp - τ enn) * τ npn

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetryFibreTower.bondSum_map {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (τ : R →+* S) (epp epn enn npp npn nnn : R) :
τ (BondCutSymmetry.bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn) = BondCutSymmetry.bondSum (τ epp) (τ epn) (τ enn) (τ npp) (τ npn) (τ nnn)
